description: Flight-line and back-shop Suitably Qualified and Experienced Personnel (SQEP) shift authorizations, Quality Assurance Representative (QAR) independent inspector availability, calibrated Special Support Equipment (SSE / JTD tooling such as JTD-53-30-T14 and NDI-PAUT-496A), and maintenance bay dispatch readiness across RAF Marham, HMS Queen Elizabeth, and HMS Prince of Wales.

fields.name: resource_id
fields.description: Primary Key (PK): Unique work center shift tooling and SQEP resource allocation identifier (e.g., RES-2026-00001).

fields.name: assigned_work_order_id
fields.description: Foreign Key (FK -> maintenance_work_orders.work_order_id): Active or historical Form 707A Work Order allocated to this bay/tooling package (e.g., 'WO-2026-88401').

fields.name: base_location
fields.description: Cluster Key: Operating location ('RAF Marham', 'HMS Queen Elizabeth', or 'HMS Prince of Wales').

fields.name: work_center
fields.description: Cluster Key: Responsible maintenance work center ('FLIGHT_LINE', 'STRUCTURES_LO', 'PROPULSION', 'AVIONICS', or 'ARMAMENT').

fields.name: supported_wuc_code
fields.description: S1000D / JTD Work Unit Code supported by the special tool and SQEP competency (e.g., '27-10', '53-30', '53-20').

fields.name: shift_code
fields.description: Active squadron maintenance shift identifier ('DAY_ALPHA', 'NIGHT_BRAVO', or 'CARRIER_WATCH_1').

fields.name: shift_lead_name
fields.description: Ranked UK MOD shift supervisor managing the work center allocation (matches maintenance_work_orders.assigned_shift_lead).

fields.name: sqep_certification_domain
fields.description: Mandatory Suitably Qualified & Experienced Personnel (SQEP) authorization stamp required by the JTD Data Module (e.g., 'SQEP-CANOPY-RIG', 'SQEP-NDI-CSCAN-L3').

fields.name: sqep_certified_techs_on_shift
fields.description: Count of currently rostered and currency-valid SQEP technicians on shift holding the required certification domain.

fields.name: qar_inspector_available
fields.description: Indicates whether an independent Quality Assurance Representative (QAR) / Red-X authority is currently on shift for dual sign-off.

fields.name: required_special_tool_id
fields.description: Serialized Special Support Equipment (SSE) or JTD precision tool identifier (e.g., 'JTD-53-30-T14', 'NDI-PAUT-496A', 'LO-IR-BLANKET-04').

fields.name: required_special_tool_name
fields.description: Nomenclature of the mandated JTD special support tool or test set (e.g., 'Digital Micro-Torque Spanner 45 in-lbs (JTD-53-30-T14)').

fields.name: calibration_expiry_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp when the tool's UKAS / military metrology calibration certificate expires.

fields.name: bay_dispatch_status
fields.description: Composite task dispatch readiness state: 'READY_TO_DISPATCH', 'BLOCKED_TOOL_OUT_OF_CAL', 'BLOCKED_NO_QAR_ON_SHIFT', or 'BLOCKED_AWAITING_MICAP_PART'.

fields.name: shift_updated_utc
fields.description: Partition Key (DAY): UTC timestamp of the latest shift handover and tool crib status synchronization.
